title: Clann - Luxury House Boat By Lisa Larkin Design
bodyHtml:
"All Aboard!"

This Month's Project Spotlight takes you on a very special tour of the interior of the Clann Luxury Houseboat, complete with breathtaking views of Lake Eildon.

With a huge outdoor deck and entertaining areas, this four bedroom, three bathroom houseboat is a shining example of luxe design.

Designed by Lisa Larkin, Clann is Modern, light & Scandinavian inspired, every room fashioned to establish a connection to the calming waters of Lake Eildon, Victoria, on which Clann calls home.

"The interior is softened by the surrounding lake and takes inspiration from relaxed living and the unique laid back Australian Lifestyle."
- Lisa Larkin

The bathrooms are indeed very special. Saturated with natural light and open views of the lake, natural textures of timber and soft stone are brought together with playful blush pinks, whites and contemporary metallic tones

Our Form basin series has found a very special home here on Clann, it's soft, rounded edges and subtle matte white finish completes the contemporary aesthetic.

"The thin edges and curves of the Studio Bagno basins were the perfect selections for this floating house. When designing the bathrooms, I wanted to capture the calmness of the lake against the boat gliding along the water."
- Lisa Larkin

Design by Lisa Larkin Design
